ATC Vet — QN03AX16. Adverse Effects and Precautions The most common adverse effects reported during therapy with pregabalin are dizziness and somnolence. Other common adverse effects include blurred vision, diplopia, increased appetite and weight gain, dry mouth, constipation, vomiting, flatulence, euphoria, confusion, reduced libido, erectile dysfunction, irrita- bility, vertigo, ataxia, tremor, dysarthria, paraesthesia, fatigue, and oedema.
